2h.1: Profits are down another 2 percent this week. At this rate, I'll go out of business soon...$s
2h.3: Greetings! How are you on this fine day? JojaMart has been full of customers.$h
2h.5: No need to despair. I know we've butted heads in the past, but I've negotiated the perfect solution.$h#$b#Joja has agreed to offer you a position as assistant manager at JojaMart in exchange for closing down your store.$h#$b#It'll come with a hefty salary increase and amazing bonuses!$h
2h.7: I know, I'd be speechless too. So when do you wish to start?$h#$b#I'd imagine you'd need a week or two to close things down here, then we can demolish the building and maybe build a Joja warehouse...
2h.8: Absolutely not! I'm not accepting your offer.$3
2h.9: You're not? But why? I spent hours on the phone with corporate working it out.$s
2h.10: Because I, unlike you, have a soul, and I don't want to give it to a huge corporation selling low-quality products imported from who-knows-where.$3
2h.11: You're making a mistake. You're choosing to live in the past. Joja is the future, and I'm sorry you can't see that.$s
2h.12: As long as people like me continue the fight, there still could be a future without Joja.$3
2h.13: I used to think like you, you know. But then I realized the error of my ways. I hope you'll come to the same conclusion someday.
4h.1: Hi, Morris. I don't see you in here often!$h
4h.2: I'm normally busy with the store so I just microwave something when I get home, but I decided to treat myself to one of your fine meals today!$h
4h.3: I'd be happy to treat you! What can I get you?
4h.16: Thanks for coming to sit with me, @. Unfortunately, I have few friends here, as you can see.$s#$b#Gus is kind to me, but that's just due to the fact that I'm a well-paying customer. No one else bothers.$s#$b#The townspeople don't understand me or Joja. We're just trying to do what's best for them. I wish they could see that.$3#$b#Pelican Town is stuck in the past, but there's so much opportunity for growth here.#$b#I do enjoy living here. I just wish I had more friends. Sometimes I wonder if I'm going about all of this the wrong way.$s#$b#When I came here, I had hoped that the people would embrace modernization. It would significantly improve their lives. I don't know how to convince them of that though.#$b#I'm glad I met you here, at least. Anyway, I had better start eating! I have a lot more work to do tonight.$h
4h.17: Thanks for sticking up for me at the saloon. It's good to know I have a friend here.$h
4h.18: Even @ left?$s#$b#I really don't have any friends here. What am I doing wrong?$s#$b#I suppose I'll go eat this at my desk. I can start on the mountain of paperwork I have to finish tonight.$s
4h.19: Oh no, I dropped my food! It's another frozen Joja pizza tonight then.$s
4h.20: Sorry @, I'm not really in the mood to talk to you at the moment.$s
6h.4: @! I didn't realize you were there.#$b#It's good to see you though! What are you doing here so early in the morning?
6h.5: Just coming to say hi? Well, hello! I'm in the middle of my morning routine at the moment. I've always enjoyed gardening, ever since I was a child.#$b#My goal has always been to make a positive change in the world and help things grow. How better to do that than by gardening?$h#$b#Anyway, no need to listen to me ramble on! I'm done watering. Why don't you come in for some coffee?
6h.6: What do you think? It's not a bad place. It's a Joja model townhouse that I've painted a cool modern grey.$h#$b#Oh, here's your coffee!
6h.8: Oh, that? That's a camera my dad bought for me before he passed. It's been a while since I've used it.#$b#I just haven't had the time since I'm so busy at JojaMart every day, plus I'm managing quite a few Joja operations in Pelican Town.
6h.9: Unfortunately, my Joja One X has had that red ring of death for a year or two now.$s#$b#I've been meaning to get around to fixing it at some point. I really enjoy video games.#$b#Again, though, Joja's just been keeping me busy, and Joja's significance greatly exceeds that of my meaningless hobbies!$h
6h.11: Same story. My mom taught me piano as a kid and bought this piano for me so I'd still have a part of her with me after I moved away.#$b#She sent me a letter last week asking what I'd played recently, and I confessed to her that I hadn't played it in months.$s#$b#She's a bit worried about the toll my work with Joja is taking on my mental health.$s#$b#I told her she had nothing to worry about, though. Devoting my entire existence to Joja is the only way to ensure that Pelican Town reaches its full potential!$h#$b#What else is there in life but Joja? Anyway, you best get going. I need to lock up and head off to work! Thanks for stopping by, @.$h
6h.12: I worry that Mom's right...$s#$b#Am I needlessly sacrificing my life for Joja? Am I ruining the lives of the people in this town instead of helping them?$s
8h1.2: I don't know how to do all of this without you, Dad.$s#$b#I'm trying to fulfill my dreams like you would have wanted, but it's difficult to stay focused now that you're gone.$s
8h1.4: Oh, @, good morning! I'm, um, just on my way to work!$h#$b#*sniffles*$h
8h1.6: I suppose you could tell I've been crying. You'd think someone working in customer service would be better at hiding it.$s#$b#You're my closest friend here, though, so I don't know why I'm trying to put on a front around you.#$b#It's my dad. He passed away recently, and it's been tough. Joja didn't let me off work to go to his funeral, which was difficult for my mom.$s#$b#It had been ages since I'd visited him, and now I never will. This isn't even his gravestone. He's buried back home. I just come here some mornings to grieve.$s
8h1.7: Do I want to talk about him? Sure, maybe that would help.#$b#He was a pretty normal father, I think. My mom mostly stayed at home with me, while he worked at an entry-level position in a Joja factory.#$b#We had enough to get by, but we weren't rich. As long as my dad got to go fishing every Sunday, he couldn't have cared less how wealthy we were.$h#$b#I was the black sheep of the family. I was full of ambition, even as a kid. I started my first lemonade stand when I was 4.$h#$b#My dad may not have understood me, but he was incredibly supportive, going out of his way to help me with every new endeavor.#$b#He even helped me get my first job with Joja after I graduated! I quickly moved up the ranks, which led to me getting the job here.$h#$b#I still remember how excited he was when I told him about it. Sad I'd be moving away of course, but so happy for me.$h
8h1.8: And then he got sick. I always knew I should go visit more often, but I kept putting it off. Now it's too late.$s#$b#My mom hasn't been coping well with it all. We write letters back and forth every week, but she's really lonely. I need to go visit soon.$s#$b#She refuses to get a phone or computer so we can talk more easily. She's always been a bit stuck in the past. She's a bit like Pelican Town in that respect, haha!$h#$b#Thanks for listening to me, @. Getting all of that off my chest made me feel a lot lighter.$h#$b#If you ever see me in the graveyard again, feel free to stop by and chat. Thanks for being my friend.$h#$b#I better head off to the store, but it was good seeing you!$h
8h1.9: You're my closest friend here, so I don't know why I'm trying to put on a front around you.#$b#It's my dad. He passed away recently, and it's been tough. 8h2.1: Oh, hello @. I was just starting to close up the store for the day. It's been a long Friday.$h#$b#I've been thinking... Would you like to accompany me to the saloon here for a late-night meal?$h#$b#I thought it might be a nice way for the two of us to start our weekends!$h#$b#Although I'll be back here again tomorrow...$s
8h2.3: Wonderful! I've been hoping to get to know you better. It'll be nice to spend some time with you outside of JojaMart, as much as I love my store.$h
8h2.4: Ah, never mind, then... I suppose you're busy, after all. $s
8h2.7: The store inventory is incorrect? One of my employees must have messed it up...$3
8h2.8: Yes, of course I'll stay late tonight to fix it, sir.$s
8h2.9: Well, @, it looks like I can't make any plans for tonight after all. I'll be spending my Friday night here.$s#$b#I really did want to go out with you tonight. I've been thinking... Oh, it's nothing.$s#$b#I hope you have a great weekend though.$h
10hcc.5: As I was saying, I saw this amazing new TV for sale when I was in the city last weekend! It had a huge screen and an extraordinarily high resolution.$h#$b#I was thinking we could get it for your house. Imagine how much fun movie nights will be with such a large TV!$h
10hcc.6: Well, true, I mainly watch 'Who Wants to Be a Billionaire', and we probably don't need to see that in high resolution, haha!$h

10hcc.8: We are! I'd like a lobster bisque. @, what would you like?$h
10hcc.10: One lobster bisque and hamburger coming right up!
10hcc.11: One lobster bisque and salad coming right up!

10hcc.26: You should have been paid more for the amount of work I made you do.$s#$b#Also, I sincerely apologize for the fact that you lost your job. That was never my intention.

10hcc.29: Heh, I don't know about that. Night.

10hj.1: You're a sight for sore eyes, @. From angry customers to store renovations, it's been a long day.#$b#I'm sorry that our last date didn't work out. 10hj.4: The company was even better. I'm glad I got to spend this time with you, @.$h
10hj.5: I know I'm always extremely dedicated to my job, and I'll readily admit to being a workaholic, but time away from Joja is good for me.$h#$b#...I realize that's ironic, considering we're sitting in JojaMart right now.#$b#I really do work too much. I'm sorry if it ever feels like I'm putting the store first. I don't mean to.$s
10hj.6: Before you arrived here, I really didn't know what to do with myself. I doubted myself much more than I let on to anyone.$s#$b#I don't have many friends here. I threw myself into Joja because it was all I had.#$b#But then you came here, and you changed everything for me. Joja's been my life for so long, but ultimately it's just a job.#$b#Yes, I really did just say that. No, I'm not drunk. Well, not THAT drunk.$h#$b#My point is that you mean a lot to me. I'm so glad you're a part of my life, @.$10
10hj.7: Anyway, it's time for me to head home, I suppose. Can't miss out on my 4 hours of sleep!$h#$b#Although, if I was ever to spend the night at your place, I bet I could get more sleep. Or not...$h
